notes: Five attempts means five mismatches; matching pairs cost no attempts.
Memory pays a single total prize for the last completed round, 5..40 coins.
Full ten-step memory sequences never repeat; shorter prefixes can coincide.
Puzzle deals are stored atomically on successful start, even if abandoned.
Memory allows ten active seconds for the entire response turn; correct taps do not reset the timer.
Main star progress is independent for all four games; puzzle history and decor survive the same save round-trip.
